history.description: A matte graphite camera shutter inside a knurled lens barrel, with a glowing four-point sparkle behind nine curved blades. The blades swing open like a real aperture, and firing snaps them shut with a brief flash of light through the seams.

definitions.name: open
definitions.description: How open the iris is, 0 to 1 (default 1). 0 is a pinhole of light, 1 is wide open. Each blade swings on its pivot, so the opening turns as it widens. The landing animates it 0 to 1 on load (~2.2 s) and eases it toward 0.55 as you scroll away.

definitions.name: fire
definitions.description: The shutter firing, 0 to 1 (default 0). From 0 to 0.35 the blades snap shut, they hold closed, and reopen by 1; a bright bloom flashes from the sparkle core out through the blade seams at the closed moment. The landing pulses it 0 to 1 over about 0.5 s: once after the iris opens, every ~7 s while the hero is visible, and on click or tap.
